verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The phone rings twice in an empty house and then stops.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust settles on the table
where two coffee cups still wait

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
morning light moves
across the rim of one cup
no one drinks it now

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone left the porch light on
though the mail keeps piling up

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a neighbor's shadow pauses
then walks on without a knock

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the calendar still shows june
though the leaves have turned twice since

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
someone finally tears the page off
and finds august waiting underneath

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the light bulb finally gives out
still nobody's fixed the switch

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
in the dark we learn the room by heart
find the door where the wall used to be

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
morning comes in anyway
a window we forgot was there

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
dust in the beam like something breathing
we open our hands and let it be light

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
someone's coat still hangs by the door
we never asked whose season it was

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the kettle knows before we do
that it's time to start again

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
steam finds the crack in the ceiling
another way out we didn't build

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the coat by the door starts to sway
no wind, just the house remembering

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
dust drifts off the collar in that light
we call it settling, not leaving
